title: Very cute!!!
text: Very cute!!!. These make cute cookies for decorations for the gingerbread houses.. They also make nice upstanding cookies. You have to keep in mind that you cant make the dough too thick or they will not fit together. I would also frost after they are together too. Give a nice dimention to any cookie trays or as a holiday decoration.
